import csv
import math
from pathlib import Path

INPUT_PATH = Path("/work/inputs/art_f01d9da1d5714eb488a662f24dfdfb6c/numbers.csv")
OUTPUT_DIR = Path("/work/outputs")
OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

values = []
with INPUT_PATH.open(newline="") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        values.append(float(row["value"]))

count = len(values)
total = float(sum(values))
mean = float(total / count) if count else 0.0

summary_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "summary.csv"
with summary_path.open("w", newline="") as f:
    f.write("count,sum,mean\n")
    f.write(f"{count},{total},{mean}\n")

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 3), dpi=100)
ax.bar(range(len(values)), values)
ax.set_xlabel("index")
ax.set_ylabel("value")
ax.set_title("value")
fig.savefig(OUTPUT_DIR / "chart.png", dpi=100)
plt.close(fig)

print({"count": count, "total": total, "mean": mean, "summary_path": str(summary_path), "chart_path": str(OUTPUT_DIR / "chart.png")})
